categories.main_business_segments: Hwaxin Environmental Co., Ltd. primarily operates in solid waste resource utilization and disposal, including electronic waste dismantling, end-of-life vehicle dismantling, waste electronic equipment recycling and reuse, and hazardous waste disposal. The company also engages in sales of dismantled products and hazardous waste treatment services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced dismantling technologies such as three-dimensional dismantling processes for TVs and computers, flat-panel TV display processing, refrigerator pre-dismantling, plastic online sorting, and foam particle gas adsorption filtration. It integrates internet technologies and proprietary ERP systems to enhance dismantling efficiency and management. The company also develops specialized processes for dismantling new energy vehicles and their components, including direct current motors, to improve recycling rates and safety.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies, large internet technology companies (e.g., ByteDance, Alibaba, Baidu), financial institutions, and individual waste collectors. The company serves markets focused on environmental protection, resource recycling, and hazardous waste management, primarily in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in North China (Beijing and surrounding areas), Southwest China (Yunnan Province), Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, and Hong Kong. The company has dismantling bases and subsidiaries strategically located in these regions to optimize resource collection and processing.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hwaxin operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the solid waste recycling supply chain, focusing on collection, dismantling, processing, and disposal of waste materials, and selling recycled materials to smelting and manufacturing enterprises. It also provides hazardous waste treatment services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation in dismantling and resource recovery, focusing on improving dismantling efficiency, environmental compliance, and hazardous waste resource utilization. R&D projects include automation of metal product packaging, exhaust gas treatment systems, and development of dismantling processes for new energy vehicles and their components. The company aims to expand hazardous waste resource recycling projects and enhance digital management systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of dismantled products (metals, plastics, glass, and parts), sales of recycled electronic equipment, government subsidies related to electronic waste dismantling, and fees for hazardous waste disposal services. The company uses direct sales and online auction platforms for product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hwaxin is one of the leading high-tech environmental protection enterprises in China specializing in solid waste resource utilization and hazardous waste disposal. It holds key industry qualifications and is among the few companies in Beijing and other regions authorized for electronic waste dismantling subsidies. The company leverages technological advantages and comprehensive service capabilities to maintain competitive positioning in a fragmented and regionally competitive market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hwaxin reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 641 million, a 12.17% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 47.2 million, down 46.69%. Total assets reached approximately RMB 2.38 billion, with a slight increase over the prior year. The company is investing heavily in hazardous waste resource projects and expanding its operational scale, aiming for sustainable growth despite short-term profit fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hwaxin emphasizes its comprehensive and integrated solid waste processing chain, combining electronic waste dismantling, vehicle dismantling, hazardous waste disposal, and resource recycling under one roof. Its technological innovations, extensive environmental qualifications, and strategic geographic presence enable it to provide high-quality, compliant, and efficient recycling services. The company’s digital platforms for sales and management enhance transparency and customer engagement, differentiating it in the environmental services market.
